description: Turn your work hours and sit:stand ratio into an alternating sit-stand schedule table.

faqs.a: Common guidance suggests standing or moving for 2–4 hours of an 8-hour day, changing posture every 30–60 minutes.
Alternate blocks (e.g. 40 min sitting, 20 min standing) rather than one long stand — variety matters more than totals.
faqs.q: Should I stand all at once?

faqs.a: Yes — the table uses 24-hour clock times starting from whatever start time you enter.
faqs.q: Can I set my own start time?

howto: Enter your total work hours for the day.
Press Build schedule and follow the alternating blocks.
title: Standing Desk Ratio Calculator
